# How Can I Handle Farm Gate Sales and Direct Orders?


You handle direct sales by recording customers and orders in a simple structure, tracking pickups or deliveries, and keeping product availability up to date, so orders received by message or phone do not get lost. On **Jestor** , this runs through customers and orders **tables** , a **Pipe** , and **WhatsApp** automation.


Direct sales can offer better margins, but they bring small, frequent orders. Managing them by memory or in chat threads leads to forgotten orders, unclear availability, and customers who do not return.


## What informal direct sales cost


- Orders forgotten between a message and the pickup day
- Products promised that are not available
- No record of regular customers and their preferences
- Payments uncertain or unrecorded
- Time spent answering the same questions repeatedly


## How direct sales tracking works


- Each customer is a **record** with contact and history
- Orders are created from a form or from a chat message
- Status moves from ordered to ready to collected
- Customers receive confirmations and reminders by message


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Orders are recorded and tracked
- Regular customers are recognized and contacted
- Availability can be updated and shared
- This scales from a roadside stand to a large direct-sales operation


Orders in chats and memory Orders recorded and tracked


Forgotten, unclear availability Confirmed, ready, and collected


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does Jestor take online payments?** No, payments are handled by your payment provider; Jestor tracks the status. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can customers order through a form?** Yes, a form can create the order directly.


**Can I send a message when an order is ready?** Yes, through WhatsApp with the native integration.
